hero_title: Report Civic Issues. Get Them Resolved Rapidly.
hero_subtitle: Empowering citizens and municipal departments with transparent, automated grievance redressal. Track real-time progress from filing to field resolution.
how_subtitle: Four simple steps from problem to verified resolution.
how_step1_desc: Take a picture of the issue, select your locality or use GPS, and submit your grievance in seconds.
how_step2_desc: Our neural system validates the image authenticity, flags duplicates, and routes the ticket directly to the right municipal division.
how_step3_desc: The assigned departmental officer inspects the ground reality, executes the repair work, and uploads resolution evidence.
how_step4_desc: You verify the work quality. If you are satisfied, the grievance closes; if not, you can escalate it with one click.
portal_citizen_desc: Report issues with photographic proof, track real-time resolution stages, receive SMS/email alerts, and confirm work completion.
portal_officer_desc: Manage assigned ward complaints, verify AI recommendations, update real-time progress, and upload geo-tagged resolution proofs.
portal_admin_desc: Executive command dashboard with live ward analytics, departmental SLA tracking, officer accountability, and automated escalations.
citizen_dashboard_subtitle: Monitor active grievances, view recent municipal announcements, and file new reports.
gc_subtitle: Submit a new complaint or track live progress across all active tickets.
form_title_placeholder: e.g., Deep pothole causing accidents near Metro Pillar 42
form_description_placeholder: Provide specific details like landmark, severity, how long the issue has persisted...
form_photo_hint: Upload a clear daytime photo showing the issue and surrounding area for verification.
form_drop_photo: Drag & drop your photo here, or click to browse
form_ai_assistant_hint: Need help writing your complaint? Ask our AI Assistant to draft it in your language!
track_subtitle: Enter your complaint ID or search your filed grievances to see live timeline updates.
track_satisfaction_prompt: Has this issue been satisfactorily resolved on the ground?
gov_dashboard_subtitle: Manage assigned tickets, inspect field evidence, and enforce departmental SLAs.
ai_widget_subtitle: Ask civic questions, draft complaints & track status in your preferred language.
ai_input_placeholder: Type your query or describe the problem in any language...
ai_emergency_banner: Emergency? Call 112 for immediate police, fire or ambulance response.
auth_login_subtitle: Enter your credentials to manage complaints or oversee departmental queues.
auth_register_subtitle: Register in 30 seconds to report municipal issues and track them in real time.
auth_forgot_subtitle: Enter your registered email address and we'll send you a 6-digit verification code.
